scope: Native requests of window-backed task source: new instance and open URLs. Pinned launchers and application-specific desktop actions retain their original route and are not covered by this environment restoration.
source: BwmTaskSource originally inherited no-op requestNewInstance/requestOpenUrls; original TasksModel forwarding now reaches the native serialized bridge and KIO startup job.

nativePolicy.desktopFormat: Original .desktop through AppData/KService; no Exec parsing
nativePolicy.menuPolicy: Native NoDisplay/SingleMainWindow/X-GNOME-SingleWindow/new-window action visibility adapted using public KService; private helper is not exported. Explicit requests remain possible as in WaylandTasksModel.
nativePolicy.metadataNotification: CanLaunchNewInstance invalidated with app metadata roles via KSycoca

environment: Process-local allowlisted original XDG/D-Bus/Qt/Wayland values captured before preview isolation. Missing/malformed context rejected; host context unchanged. BWM_R4 flags, skin transition flag and consumed Wayland socket excluded from launched application.
lifecycle: Shared transaction/skin/address/PID/process-start revalidation, existing bounded queue and quiescence; launcher starts in a separate process session, bounded input/KIO deadline; CLOEXEC receipt fd prevents app output from retaining/corrupting the reply. Startup acceptance does not establish application readiness or focus.
